SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.XCL_006 = '=' THEN m.XCL_010 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 /
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.XCL_010)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.XCL_002 = m.XCL_010
LEFT JOIN bond b ON b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'non-carcinogenic'
  AND a.XCL_003 = 'S'
